entries.reason: The stamp shell owns three persistent layout slots; this portal moves ordinary layer controls into the shell and does not create a floating layer.
entries.verification: The target is props.layersHost, stays in document flow, and has no backdrop, z-index, focus trap, Escape dismissal, or overlay positioning.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when the stamp shell and editor share a component boundary or a public named-host-slot recipe replaces this layout bridge.
